summary: This eShop Modernizing repository demonstrates a strangler-fig migration from legacy ASP.NET MVC5/WebAPI2 (.NET Framework 4.7.2) to ASP.NET Core 2.2 (targeting net461). Both implementations provide identical catalog CRUD functionality with models, services, controllers, and data access layers. Extracted acceptance criteria cover primary journeys (catalog browsing with pagination, item CRUD), validation constraints (price range 0–1,000,000, stock limits 0–10,000,000), pagination logic, anti-forgery protection, MIME type resolution, and reference data seeding. The extraction is constrained by incomplete evidence on conditional service selection (UseMockData flag wiring) and some validation error handling flows. All criteria are grounded in repository evidence; inferences are minimal and recorded as unresolved questions.

criteria.title: Catalog Item Pagination with Default Page Size
criteria.given: A user opens the catalog index page without specifying page parameters
criteria.when: CatalogController.Index() is invoked with default query parameters (pageSize=10, pageIndex=0)
criteria.then: The service retrieves total item count, skips 0 items, takes 10 items from database, calculates TotalPages = ceil(count/10), populates PaginatedItemsViewModel with ActualPage=0, ItemsPerPage=10, Data containing first 10 items, and renders View with pagination controls showing Next enabled if TotalPages > 1
criteria.verification_method: Integration test: navigate to /Catalog/Index, verify HTTP 200 response, assert ViewModel.ActualPage == 0, ViewModel.ItemsPerPage == 10, ViewModel.Data.Count <= 10, pagination UI rendered correctly

evidence.observation: Index(int pageSize = 10, int pageIndex = 0) calls service.GetCatalogItemsPaginated(pageSize, pageIndex)
GetCatalogItemsPaginated calculates totalItems = _context.CatalogItems.Count(), creates ViewModel with TotalPages = (int)Math.Ceiling(((decimal)count / pageSize)), skips and takes results

criteria.title: Catalog Item Pagination with Custom Page Size
criteria.given: A user requests a catalog page with custom pageSize and pageIndex parameters
criteria.when: CatalogController.Index(pageSize=5, pageIndex=2) is invoked
criteria.then: Service calculates skip = 5 * 2 = 10, takes 5 items starting at offset 10, TotalPages = ceil(count/5), ViewModel.ActualPage = 2, ViewModel.ItemsPerPage = 5, View renders page 2 with 5 items and pagination controls showing Previous and Next as appropriate
criteria.verification_method: Integration test: navigate to /Catalog/Index?pageSize=5&pageIndex=2, assert ViewModel.ActualPage == 2, ViewModel.ItemsPerPage == 5, ViewModel.Data.Count <= 5, verify second page items differ from first page

evidence.observation: GetCatalogItemsPaginated applies Skip(pageSize * pageIndex).Take(pageSize) to LINQ query
Constructor accepts pageSize, pageIndex parameters and populates ActualPage = pageIndex, ItemsPerPage = pageSize

criteria.title: Price Validation: Regex Pattern and Range Constraint
criteria.given: An admin creates a new catalog item with a price value
criteria.when: CatalogItem.Create form is submitted with Price = '19.99'
criteria.then: Model validation applies [RegularExpression(@"^\d+(\.\d{0,2})*$")] and [Range(0, 1000000)] attributes, regex pattern validates format (positive decimal with max 2 decimals), Range validates 0 <= Price <= 1000000, ModelState.IsValid returns true, item is persisted
criteria.verification_method: Unit test: instantiate CatalogItem with Price=19.99, call validator, assert no errors. Test with Price=19.999 (too many decimals), assert regex validation error. Test with Price=-5, assert Range validation error. Test with Price=1000001, assert Range validation error.

evidence.observation: [RegularExpression(@"^\d+(\.\d{0,2})*$", ErrorMessage = "The field Price must be a positive number with maximum two decimals.")] [Range(0, 1000000)] public decimal Price
Identical price validation constraints in legacy codebase

criteria.title: Stock Availability Range Validation
criteria.given: An admin edits a catalog item and modifies the AvailableStock field
criteria.when: CatalogItem.Edit form is submitted with AvailableStock = '5000000'
criteria.then: Model validation applies [Range(0, 10000000, ErrorMessage = "The field Stock must be between 0 and 10 million.")] attribute, Range validator confirms 0 <= AvailableStock <= 10000000, ModelState.IsValid returns true, item persists with updated stock
criteria.verification_method: Unit test: instantiate CatalogItem with AvailableStock=5000000, assert validator passes. Test AvailableStock=-1, assert Range error. Test AvailableStock=10000001, assert Range error.

evidence.observation: [Range(0, 10000000, ErrorMessage = "The field Stock must be between 0 and 10 million.")] public int AvailableStock

criteria.title: Restock Threshold Validation
criteria.given: An admin sets the RestockThreshold for a catalog item
criteria.when: CatalogItem form is submitted with RestockThreshold = '7500000'
criteria.then: Model validation applies [Range(0, 10000000)] attribute, validator confirms threshold within bounds, ModelState.IsValid returns true, RestockThreshold is persisted
criteria.verification_method: Unit test: test RestockThreshold at boundary (0, 10000000, outside range); verify only valid values persist

evidence.observation: [Range(0, 10000000, ErrorMessage = "The field Restock must be between 0 and 10 million.")] public int RestockThreshold

criteria.title: Max Stock Threshold Validation
criteria.given: An admin configures the MaxStockThreshold for warehouse capacity
criteria.when: CatalogItem form is submitted with MaxStockThreshold = '9000000'
criteria.then: Model validation applies [Range(0, 10000000, ErrorMessage = "The field Max stock must be between 0 and 10 million.")] attribute, validator confirms within warehouse constraint, ModelState.IsValid returns true, MaxStockThreshold is persisted
criteria.verification_method: Unit test: test boundary values (0, 10000000, out-of-range); verify persistence only for valid thresholds

evidence.observation: [Range(0, 10000000, ErrorMessage = "The field Max stock must be between 0 and 10 million.")] public int MaxStockThreshold

criteria.title: Catalog Item Name Required and Length Validation
criteria.given: An admin creates a new catalog item without a name or with excessive length
criteria.when: CatalogItem.Create form is submitted with Name=null or Name.Length > 50
criteria.then: Model validation applies [Required] and [MaxLength(50)] attributes, validator reports Name is required if null/empty, or exceeds max length error if > 50 chars, ModelState.IsValid returns false, form is re-rendered with validation error message, item is not persisted
criteria.verification_method: Unit test: submit form with Name=null, assert Required error. Submit with Name='a'*51, assert MaxLength error. Submit with valid Name, assert no error and persistence.

evidence.observation: [Required] [MaxLength(50)] public string Name

criteria.title: Picture File Name Default Assignment
criteria.given: An admin creates a catalog item without explicitly specifying PictureFileName
criteria.when: CatalogItem() constructor is called with no PictureFileName parameter
criteria.then: Constructor assigns PictureFileName = 'dummy.png' (DefaultPictureName constant), item retains this default on database insert unless overridden
criteria.verification_method: Unit test: instantiate CatalogItem() with default constructor, assert PictureFileName == 'dummy.png'. Test with explicit PictureFileName override, assert override value is retained.

evidence.observation: public const string DefaultPictureName = "dummy.png"; constructor sets if PictureFileName not provided, [Required] attribute enforces persistence

criteria.title: Picture URI Construction for Ported Application
criteria.given: A catalog item is displayed in the ported eShopPorted application
criteria.when: CatalogController.Index or Details action executes AddUriPlaceHolder() method
criteria.then: PictureUri is constructed as '/Pics/{item.Id}.png' (relative URL path), image element src is set to this URI, when client requests /items/{itemId}/pic, PicController resolves and serves the image file
criteria.verification_method: Integration test: navigate to /Catalog/Index, inspect HTML img src attributes, verify format matches '/Pics/\d+\.png'. Request /items/1/pic, assert HTTP 200 and image binary content returned.

evidence.observation: AddUriPlaceHolder method sets item.PictureUri = $"/Pics/{item.Id}.png"

criteria.title: Anti-Forgery Token Validation on Mutation Endpoints
criteria.given: An admin submits a catalog item form via POST (Create, Edit, DeleteConfirmed)
criteria.when: POST request to /Catalog/Create, /Catalog/Edit, or /Catalog/DeleteConfirmed is submitted without or with invalid __RequestVerificationToken
criteria.then: [ValidateAntiForgeryToken] attribute intercepts request, validates token against session/cookie, if invalid or missing returns HTTP 400 Bad Request (AntiForgeryValidationException), request is not processed; if valid, form processing continues
criteria.verification_method: Security test: submit POST without token, verify 400 Bad Request. Submit with valid token (captured from form), verify request succeeds. Verify token is unique per session (CSRF protection).

evidence.observation: [ValidateAntiForgeryToken] decorates Create(POST), Edit(POST), and DeleteConfirmed(POST) methods
Same CSRF protection in legacy controller

criteria.title: Create New Catalog Item Flow
criteria.given: An admin navigates to /Catalog/Create and completes the form with valid data
criteria.when: CatalogController.Create(GET) loads form, admin fills Name='Test Item', Price=25.50, CatalogBrandId=2, CatalogTypeId=1, AvailableStock=100, submits POST with valid anti-forgery token
criteria.then: POST handler validates ModelState (all required fields, price format, stock range), calls service.CreateCatalogItem(catalogItem), service persists item (legacy: assigns ID via HiLo generator, ported: EF Core assigns IDENTITY), HTTP redirect returns to /Catalog/Index, new item appears in catalog list
criteria.verification_method: Integration test: load /Catalog/Create, submit valid form, verify HTTP 302 redirect to Index. Query database, verify new item exists with correct Name, Price, Brand, Type. Verify item appears in paginated list.

evidence.observation: [HttpPost] Create(CatalogItem catalogItem) validates ModelState, calls service.CreateCatalogItem(catalogItem), redirects to Index on success
CreateCatalogItem instantiates DbContext, adds item to _context.CatalogItems, saves changes

criteria.title: Edit Catalog Item Flow
criteria.given: An admin navigates to /Catalog/Edit/{id} for an existing item
criteria.when: CatalogController.Edit(GET, id=5) loads the form, admin modifies Price from 19.99 to 24.99, updates AvailableStock from 50 to 75, submits POST with valid anti-forgery token
criteria.then: POST handler validates ModelState, calls service.UpdateCatalogItem(catalogItem) with EntityState.Modified, service merges changes into DbContext, SaveChanges persists updates, HTTP redirect returns to /Catalog/Index, modified item reflects new values in catalog
criteria.verification_method: Integration test: load /Catalog/Edit/5, verify form pre-populated with current values. Modify fields, submit, verify redirect to Index. Query item 5, verify Price and AvailableStock updated. Load Edit/5 again, verify new values displayed.

evidence.observation: [HttpPost] Edit(CatalogItem catalogItem) validates ModelState, calls service.UpdateCatalogItem(catalogItem), redirects to Index on success
UpdateCatalogItem sets DbContext entry to EntityState.Modified and SaveChanges()

criteria.title: Delete Catalog Item Flow
criteria.given: An admin navigates to /Catalog/Delete/{id} to remove an item
criteria.when: CatalogController.Delete(GET, id=3) displays confirmation, admin clicks delete, POST to DeleteConfirmed(id=3) with valid anti-forgery token
criteria.then: DeleteConfirmed handler calls service.RemoveCatalogItem(id), service loads item from DbContext, removes item, SaveChanges commits deletion, HTTP redirect returns to /Catalog/Index, deleted item no longer appears in catalog
criteria.verification_method: Integration test: load /Catalog/Delete/3, verify confirmation page shows item details. Submit delete, verify HTTP 302 redirect. Query item 3 from database, verify it does not exist. Load /Catalog/Index, verify item 3 missing from list.

evidence.observation: [HttpPost, ActionName("Delete")] DeleteConfirmed(int id) calls service.RemoveCatalogItem(id), redirects to Index
RemoveCatalogItem finds item by id, removes from DbContext, SaveChanges

criteria.title: Image MIME Type Resolution for Picture Serving
criteria.given: A client requests an image via /items/{itemId}/pic
criteria.when: PicController.Index(catalogItemId=2) is invoked, item has PictureFileName='test.png'
criteria.then: PicController.GetImageMimeTypeFromImageFileExtension(imageFileExtension) extracts extension '.png' and returns 'image/png', file is read from disk, response is returned with Content-Type header set to 'image/png', image displays correctly in browser
criteria.verification_method: Integration test: load /items/1/pic, verify HTTP 200 response. Check Content-Type header, assert matches expected MIME type for image format. Test multiple extensions (.jpg, .png, .gif, etc.), verify each returns correct MIME type.

evidence.observation: GetImageMimeTypeFromImageFileExtension switches on extension: '.png' → 'image/png', '.jpg'|'.jpeg' → 'image/jpeg', '.gif' → 'image/gif', default → 'application/octet-stream'

criteria.title: REST API GET /api/brands Endpoint
criteria.given: A client requests the catalog brands API endpoint
criteria.when: GET /api/brands is invoked
criteria.then: BrandsController.Index() calls service.GetCatalogBrands(), returns IActionResult Ok(brands) with JSON-serialized list of CatalogBrand objects (Id, Brand properties), HTTP 200 response with Content-Type: application/json, client receives all available catalog brands
criteria.verification_method: Integration test: GET /api/brands, verify HTTP 200. Parse JSON response, verify it contains array of objects with Id and Brand properties. Verify all 5 preconfigured brands present (Azure, .NET, Visual Studio, SQL Server, Other).

evidence.observation: [ApiController] public IActionResult Index() => Ok(_service.GetCatalogBrands())

criteria.title: REST API DELETE /api/brands/{id} Endpoint
criteria.given: A client requests deletion of a brand via REST API
criteria.when: DELETE /api/brands/{id} is invoked with id=2 (.NET brand)
criteria.then: BrandsController.Delete(id=2) calls service.GetCatalogBrands().FirstOrDefault(b => b.Id == 2), if found removes brand and returns Ok(), if not found returns NotFound(), HTTP 404 response if brand not found, HTTP 200 if deleted
criteria.verification_method: Integration test: DELETE /api/brands/2, verify HTTP 200 Ok response. GET /api/brands, verify brand 2 no longer in list. DELETE /api/brands/999, verify HTTP 404 NotFound.

evidence.observation: [HttpDelete("{id}")] public IActionResult Delete(int id) => brand == null ? NotFound() : Ok()

criteria.then: 5 catalog brands are inserted (Id 1-5): Azure, .NET, Visual Studio, SQL Server, Other; each brand retains its seeded ID and Name across environment resets, brands are available in dropdown selectors on Create/Edit forms
criteria.verification_method: Integration test: apply migration, query CatalogBrand table, verify exactly 5 rows exist with expected names and IDs. Load /Catalog/Create, inspect ViewBag.CatalogBrandId SelectList, verify all 5 brands present in dropdown.

evidence.observation: builder.HasData(PreconfiguredData.GetPreconfiguredCatalogBrands()) applies HasData() seeding with 5 hardcoded brands
GetPreconfiguredCatalogBrands returns List<CatalogBrand> with Azure, .NET, Visual Studio, SQL Server, Other

criteria.then: 4 catalog types are inserted (Id 1-4): Mug, T-Shirt, Sheet, USB Memory Stick; types are available in dropdown selectors on Create/Edit forms, type IDs persist across environment resets

GetPreconfiguredCatalogTypes returns hardcoded list of 4 types

criteria.title: Model Validation Error Display on Create Form Failure
criteria.given: An admin submits a catalog item creation form with invalid data (e.g., Name=null, Price=invalid format)
criteria.when: CatalogController.Create(POST, catalogItem) is called with invalid ModelState
criteria.then: [ValidateAntiForgeryToken] passes, ModelState.IsValid returns false, controller repopulates ViewBag.CatalogBrandId and ViewBag.CatalogTypeId SelectLists, returns View(catalogItem) with the same form, HTML form helper displays validation error messages for each invalid field (e.g., 'Name is required', 'Price must match pattern'), user can correct and resubmit
criteria.verification_method: Integration test: POST /Catalog/Create with missing Name, verify HTTP 200 form re-render (not redirect). Inspect HTML, verify validation error messages displayed. Verify form retains submitted values for resubmission. Test price regex error, verify 'positive number with maximum two decimals' error shown.

evidence.observation: [HttpPost] Create(CatalogItem) checks if (!ModelState.IsValid) then returns View(catalogItem) with popul ViewBag dropdowns

criteria.title: Catalog Item Details View
criteria.given: A user clicks 'Details' link for a catalog item or navigates to /Catalog/Details/{id}
criteria.when: CatalogController.Details(id=5) is invoked
criteria.then: If id is null, returns BadRequest(). If item not found, returns NotFound(). If found, service.FindCatalogItem(id) retrieves item, AddUriPlaceHolder() sets PictureUri, View displays item details (Name, Description, Price, Brand, Type, Stock levels, Picture), user can navigate back or edit
criteria.verification_method: Integration test: GET /Catalog/Details/5, verify HTTP 200 and item details displayed. GET /Catalog/Details/null or /Catalog/Details/999, verify HTTP 400/404. Verify image URI constructed as /Pics/5.png.

evidence.observation: Details(id?) returns BadRequest if null, NotFound if item not found, View(catalogItem) if found

coverage_gaps: Conditional service registration logic (UseMockData vs real service) not explicitly evidenced in DI modules — test coverage for mock vs real service switching unclear
Reorder logic trigger conditions (OnReorder = true) not documented or tested — when/why does stock status change OnReorder flag?
Database transaction semantics for concurrent creates/updates not evidenced — potential race condition risk in distributed scenarios
Legacy HiLo ID generation conflict resolution not covered in ported app — how are legacy IDs migrated to EF Core IDENTITY without collision?
File storage location for PictureFileName not fully specified — legacy uses Server.MapPath('~/Pics'), ported location unclear
MIME type resolution for unknown extensions (default 'application/octet-stream') behavior not validated in test cases
Picture file not-found handling (item.PictureFileName = 'missing.png') not explicitly covered — does PicController return 404 or fallback?
REST API error scenarios (serialization failures, database errors) not fully specified for Brands/Files endpoints
unresolved_questions: How is the UseMockData flag in appsettings.json conditionally wired in the Autofac DI container? The logic is not evident in eShopPorted/Modules/ApplicationModule.cs.
Does the legacy app also support conditional mock/real service selection, and if so, what is the configuration mechanism?
When does CatalogItem.OnReorder flag change from false to true? Is this a manual admin action or automatic based on AvailableStock < RestockThreshold?
In the ported app, where are image files physically stored? Is it a configurable path, or does PicController expect files in a specific relative location?
For the legacy app's HiLo ID generation, what happens if the sequence reaches its maximum value? Is there overflow handling?
Are there any business rules governing updates to already-persisted items? E.g., can CatalogTypeId or CatalogBrandId be changed post-creation, or is that prohibited?
